verdict.rationale: The platform supports Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu) deployment, provides CLI tooling (xrt-smi) for monitoring/management, and offers Python/C++/server APIs that don't require a GUI, all of which are prerequisites for headless/automated use. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI/CD pipeline integration, containerized/Docker deployment, or automated testing/build examples for the NPU stack. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD examples, container/Docker support, automated headless test harnesses, and independent confirmation of headless operation in production pipelines.
